metadata.title: Beane et al. (2011) Chem. Biol. 18:77-89 & Pietak-Levin (2017) Planarian H,K-ATPase Bioelectric V_mem & Voltage-Gated Gap-Junction Anterior Polarity Reference Dataset

sources.citation: Beane WS, Morokuma J, Adams DS, Levin M (2011). A bioelectric mechanism for H,K-ATPase-mediated control of anterior-posterior polarity in planarian regeneration. Chemistry & Biology 18(1):77-89.

Oviedo NJ, Morokuma J, Walentek P, Kema IP, Gu MB, Ahn JM, Hwang JS, Gojobori T, Levin M (2010). Long-range neural and gap junction protein-mediated cues control polarity during planarian regeneration. Developmental Biology 339(1):188-199.

Pietak A, Levin M (2017). Bioelectric gene and reaction networks: computational modeling of genetic, biochemical, and bioelectrical dynamics in pattern regulation. Journal of the Royal Society Interface 14(134):20170425.

Durant F, Morokuma J, Fields C, Williams K, Adams DS, Levin M (2017). Long-term, stochastic editing of regenerative anatomy via targeting endogenous bioelectric gradients. Biophysical Journal 112(10):2231-2243.

schmidtea_mediterranea_specimen.species: Schmidtea mediterranea (Freshwater planarian flatworm, dorsal bright-field whole-mount showing anterior head, bilateral photoreceptor ocelli, pigmented trunk, and tapering tail; 1H1T wild-type polarity)

governing_equations.section: Beane et al. (2011) Chem. Biol. 18:77-89 Figs. 1-6 & Pietak-Levin (2017) J. R. Soc. Interface 14:20170425 Eqs. (1)-(8)
governing_equations.vmem_pde: C_m * dV/dt = -g_bistable * (V - V_hyper) * (V - V_thresh) * (V - V_depol) + I_HK(x) + I_IVM(x) + d/dx [ G_GJ(dV/dx) * dV/dx ]
governing_equations.anterior_head_gene_pde: tau_H * dH/dt = Ca_ss(V) * (1 - c_T * T) - H + D_H * d^2H/dx^2
governing_equations.posterior_tail_gene_pde: tau_T * dT/dt = (1 - Ca_ss(V)) * W(x) * (1 - c_H * H) - T + D_T * d^2T/dx^2
governing_equations.boundary_conditions: Zero-flux Neumann boundary conditions dV/dx = dH/dx = dT/dx = 0 at amputated anterior wound (x = 0) and posterior wound (x = L)

bistable_attractors.slope_at_hyper: g_bistable * (V_hyper - V_thresh) * (V_hyper - V_depol) = g_bistable * (-22.5) * (-45.0) > 0 (stable hyperpolarized posterior attractor)
bistable_attractors.slope_at_depol: g_bistable * (V_depol - V_hyper) * (V_depol - V_thresh) = g_bistable * (+45.0) * (+22.5) > 0 (stable depolarized anterior attractor)

wild_type_1H1T.label: Wild-Type Trunk Regeneration (Intact H,K-ATPase + Gap Junctions)
wild_type_1H1T.beane2011_reference: Beane et al. (2011) Fig. 1A & Fig. 2A: Anterior blastema depolarizes (DiBAC4(3) bright, V_mem ~ -20 mV), elevating Ca2+ and pc2/ndk to form 1 anterior head and 1 posterior tail (100% 1H1T, n=125).

hk_atpase_inhibited_0H2T.label: H,K-ATPase Inhibition (Smed-H,K-ATPase RNAi / SCH-28080 Hyperpolarization)
hk_atpase_inhibited_0H2T.beane2011_reference: Beane et al. (2011) Fig. 1B-D & Fig. 2B: Loss of H,K-ATPase blocks anterior wound depolarization (V_mem remains hyperpolarized ~ -65 mV), abolishing anterior Ca2+ influx and yielding 100% headless regenerates (0H, n=94).

ivermectin_depolarized_2H0T.label: Ivermectin Depolarization Rescue / Ectopic Anteriorization (GluCl Opener)
ivermectin_depolarized_2H0T.beane2011_reference: Beane et al. (2011) Fig. 3 & Fig. 4: Ivermectin-induced Cl- efflux depolarizes both anterior and posterior blastemas above V_thresh (V_mem ~ -20 mV), rescuing head formation under H,K-ATPase blockade and inducing double-headed (2H0T) planarians (72% ectopic anteriorization).

octanol_gj_blockade_2H0T.label: 8-Octanol Gap-Junction Blockade (Innexin Uncoupling -> Double-Head 2H0T)
octanol_gj_blockade_2H0T.beane2011_reference: Oviedo et al. (2010) Dev. Biol. 339:188-199 & Durant et al. (2017) Biophys. J. 112:2231-2243: Blocking innexin gap junctions (eta_oct = 0.92) isolates posterior wound depolarization from hyperpolarized trunk clearance, producingcryptic/permanent 2H0T double-headed planarians.

nifedipine_cav_block_0H2T.label: Nifedipine Ca_v Channel Blockade Control (Depolarized V_mem but Blocked Ca2+ Gate -> 0H)
nifedipine_cav_block_0H2T.beane2011_reference: Beane et al. (2011) Fig. 5 & Fig. 6: Blocking voltage-gated Ca2+ channels with nifedipine decouples V_mem depolarization from anterior gene expression (Ca_ss -> 0), preventing head regeneration (0H) despite anterior depolarization.
